content: Spouses disputed the ownership of a garage and the husband’s claim for an occupancy indemnity. The wife argued the garage was a personal gift from her father. The Court rejected the husband’s indemnity claim because he failed to prove he was physically excluded from the property. Simultaneously, it rejected the wife’s claim of personal ownership because she failed to provide certain and documented proof that her father paid the price directly. Consequently, the asset was declared 50/50 common property and slated for sale.
